title: Kadavul Padaitha Manidargal
desc: The lives of two mortal orphans undergo a series of upheavals thanks to a quarrel between Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Vishnu. It all begins when the two mortals are caught in the drama of a don's life.

title: Silukkuvarupatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Gandhi Kannadi
desc: An event organizer orchestrates a grand diamond jubilee for an elderly gentleman. This profound assignment facilitates an unexpected journey involving sentimental aspirations and sincere bonds.

title: Good Night
desc: Mohan, an IT employee, has a perennial snoring problem. Later, when he gets married, his issue strains his marital relationship.

title: Kaariyavadhi
desc: A shrewd man runs a market to solely reap its profits. Soon, a young man falls in love with his daughter and stands against his authoritative rule.

title: Siruthai
desc: Rocket Raja, a small-time thief, comes across a young girl who calls him father. However, when Raja finds the truth about the girl's past, he turns into a vigilante.

title: Veerabali
desc: A happy-go-lucky man is forced to adopt violent means to avenge his parents' ruthless murders. So, with the help of his love, he sets out to punish the culprits.
